items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: free-for-dev
items.summary: free-for-dev 是一个精心整理的 GitHub 资源库，专门为开发者和运维人员解决寻找实用免费云服务的难题。它通过社区协作维护分类列表，收录 SaaS、PaaS 和 IaaS 中提供可持续免费层级的服务，过滤掉短期试用，突出真正可用的选项。你可以直接浏览列表，快速找到用于测试、原型开发或学习的免费工具，如云主机、数据库或监控服务，还能提交遗漏服务，帮助社区共同完善资源。
items.summary_en: free-for-dev is a curated GitHub repository that solves the challenge of discovering genuinely useful free-tier cloud services for developers and DevOps teams. It works by maintaining a community-driven, categorized list of SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS offerings with meaningful free tiers, filtering out limited trials to highlight sustainable options. You can browse it to quickly find free tools for testing, prototyping, or learning—like cloud hosting, databases, or monitoring services—and contribute missing services to help others.

items.name: agency-agents
items.summary: Agency-agents是一个开源框架，旨在简化多智能体AI系统的构建。它通过提供预配置的专用智能体，解决协调多样化AI能力的复杂性。每个智能体具有独特的个性和处理流程，支持模块化协作，适用于前端开发、内容审核等特定任务。开发者可通过API快速部署智能体，定制现有智能体以适应新领域，或组合它们构建复杂工作流。该框架适用于自动化多步骤、多专业知识项目，鼓励用户创建智能体团队解决实际问题。
items.summary_en: Agency-agents is an open-source framework that simplifies building multi-agent AI systems by providing pre-configured specialized agents, addressing the complexity of coordinating diverse AI capabilities. Its key insight is structuring agents with distinct personalities and processes, enabling modular collaboration where each agent handles specific tasks like frontend development or content moderation. Developers can deploy these agents via the provided API, customize existing agents for new domains, or combine them to create complex workflows, making it practical for automating multi-step projects requiring varied expertise.

items.name: AI-For-Beginners
items.summary: 微软推出的《AI-For-Beginners》为免费AI入门课程，共12周24课，适合零基础学习者。课程涵盖计算机视觉、自然语言处理、生成对抗网络等核心领域，每课配有Jupyter Notebook实战练习。其特色在于理论与编码紧密结合，每节课引导完成一个小项目，帮助理解概念并积累经验。该课程大纲适用于自学或教学，系统掌握AI基础。
items.summary_en: Microsoft's AI-For-Beginners is a free 12-week, 24-lesson curriculum designed to make AI accessible to anyone. It covers fundamental concepts across computer vision, NLP, GANs, and more, using hands-on Jupyter Notebooks. Each lesson combines theory with practical code, enabling learners to build real-world projects. Perfect for self-study or classroom use, it provides a structured path from basics to advanced topics. Ideal for beginners who want to dive into AI with a trusted, well-organized resource.

items.name: Vibe-Trading
items.summary: Vibe-Trading 是一个开源的个人交易代理工具，通过多智能体协作与大型语言模型的结合，实现市场分析与交易执行的自动化。其核心优势在于将实时市场数据与AI决策相融合，允许用户在实盘部署前对策略进行回测验证。技术亮点包括可定制的代理角色、通过API对接交易所，以及采用市场上下文协议（MCP）处理结构化数据。你可以在GitHub上获取代码，自行构建或调整交易策略，适用于算法交易爱好者和金融科技研究者探索AI驱动的量化交易方案。
items.summary_en: Vibe-Trading is an open-source personal trading agent that integrates LLMs with multi-agent collaboration to automate market analysis and trade execution. Its core strength lies in combining real-time market data with AI-driven decision-making, enabling users to backtest strategies before deploying them live. You can customize agent roles, integrate with exchanges via APIs, and leverage MCP (Market Context Protocol) for structured data. Ideal for algorithmic traders and fintech enthusiasts seeking a flexible, AI-powered trading assistant.

items.name: video-use
items.summary: video-use 是一个开源工具，通过编写代码实现视频编辑，解决了复杂或重复剪辑任务的自动化问题。其核心是将视频操作视为可编程流水线，由代码智能体根据自然语言指令或脚本执行裁剪、转场、特效和叠加。技术上打通了大型语言模型与视频处理库，实现动态、上下文感知的编辑而无需手动时间线操作。可用于批量处理教程、生成个性化视频片段或将视频编辑嵌入AI工作流——只需定义规则，智能体即可完成剪辑。
items.summary_en: video-use is an open-source tool that enables video editing through code, addressing the challenge of automating complex or repetitive editing tasks. Its core approach treats video manipulation as a programmable pipeline: a coding agent interprets natural language instructions or scripts to perform cuts, transitions, effects, and overlays. Technically, it integrates large language models with video processing libraries, allowing dynamic, context-aware edits without manual timeline work. Users can batch-process tutorials, generate personalized clips, or embed video editing into AI workflows by defining rules and letting the agent execute the edits.

items.name: herdr
items.summary: Herdr 是终端智能体多路复用器，专为同时管理多个AI编程助手（如Claude Code、Codex）设计。其核心创新为并行处理多个智能体的输入输出流，实现协作解决问题，避免手动切换窗口。基于Rust开发，具有低延迟和高可靠性。开发者可分发不同代码任务、对比结果或结合多种AI能力，应对复杂调试、代码生成与探索式编程。一条命令即可启动多智能体协作会话，显著提升开发
items.summary_en: Herdr is a terminal-based tool that runs and orchestrates multiple AI coding agents (like Claude Code, Codex) concurrently. Its core innovation is multiplexing agent inputs and outputs, enabling collaborative problem-solving without manual window switching. Built in Rust, it offers fast, reliable performance with low overhead. Developers can use herdr to delegate tasks to different agents, compare their outputs, or combine their strengths—ideal for complex debugging, code generation, or exploratory programming where diverse AI perspectives add value.

items.name: lingbot-map
items.summary: lingbot-map是一个前馈式的3D基础模型，专为从流式数据（如视频或传感器实时输入）重建场景而设计。与传统的SLAM或离线重建不同，它的前馈架构能够以单次前向传播处理数据，避免了迭代优化，从而在保证鲁棒性的同时实现极低延迟的实时3D理解。这一特性使其特别适用于自动驾驶导航、机器人操作或AR/VR等需要快速感知动态环境的场景。实践中，只需将相机或LiDAR数据流输入模型，即可直接获得稠密的3D重建结果，便于集成到现有感知管线中。
items.summary_en: lingbot-map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model that reconstructs scenes from streaming data, enabling real-time 3D understanding from video or sensor streams. Unlike traditional SLAM or offline reconstruction, its feed-forward architecture processes data in a single pass, avoiding iterative optimization for speed and robustness. This makes it ideal for applications like autonomous navigation, robotic manipulation, or AR/VR where low-latency scene understanding is critical. You can integrate it into a perception pipeline by feeding camera or LiDAR streams and obtain dense 3D reconstructions directly.
items.summary_zh: lingbot-map是一个前馈式的3D基础模型，专为从流式数据（如视频或传感器实时输入）重建场景而设计。与传统的SLAM或离线重建不同，它的前馈架构能够以单次前向传播处理数据，避免了迭代优化，从而在保证鲁棒性的同时实现极低延迟的实时3D理解。这一特性使其特别适用于自动驾驶导航、机器人操作或AR/VR等需要快速感知动态环境的场景。实践中，只需将相机或LiDAR数据流输入模型，即可直接获得稠密的3D重建结果，便于集成到现有感知管线中。
items.summary_es: lingbot-map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model that reconstructs scenes from streaming data, enabling real-time 3D understanding from video or sensor streams. Unlike traditional SLAM or offline reconstruction, its feed-forward architecture processes data in a single pass, avoiding iterative optimization for speed and robustness. This makes it ideal for applications like autonomous navigation, robotic manipulation, or AR/VR where low-latency scene understanding is critical. You can integrate it into a perception pipeline by feeding camera or LiDAR streams and obtain dense 3D reconstructions directly.

items.name: ai-berkshire
items.summary: ai-berkshire 是一个开源的价值投资研究框架，融合巴菲特、芒格、段永平和李录四位大师的投资方法论。通过多智能体对抗分析，模拟大师们对同一标的进行辩论，从而生成多维度的投资洞察。技术上，它利用 Claude Code 或 Codex 驱动智能体，实现并行研究。你可以将其部署在本地，对A股或港股进行深度基本面分析，也可以扩展新的方法论或智能体角色，定制自己的投资研究流程。
items.summary_en: ai-berkshire is an open-source value investing research framework that combines wisdom from Buffett, Munger, Duan Yongping, and Li Lu. It uses multi-agent adversarial analysis to evaluate Chinese stocks, leveraging Claude Code or Codex. Technically, it simulates master investors debating to generate diverse insights. You can run it locally to analyze your own stock picks or extend it with new methodologies.

items.name: exercises-dataset
items.summary: 这是一个包含433个健身动作的全面数据集，每个动作均提供名称、分类、目标肌群、所需器材、执行步骤、缩略图及动画视频。其结构化设计便于直接解析，可用于构建健身推荐系统、个性化训练计划或运动教学平台。优势在于数据完整、格式统一，开发者可快速按肌群或器材筛选，集成到各类应用中。无论是构建动作库还是生成训练方案，该数据集都能显著降低数据收集成本，让开发者聚焦于交互和算法优化。
items.summary_en: A comprehensive dataset of 433 fitness exercises, each with structured metadata including name, category, target muscle group, equipment, instructions, thumbnail image, and animation video. This open-source resource is ideal for powering fitness apps, workout planners, or educational tools. Its clean, consistent format simplifies integration into recommendation systems or instructional content. Developers can directly parse the JSON to build exercise libraries or filter by muscle group and equipment.

items.name: FluidVoice
items.summary: FluidVoice 是一款专为 macOS 设计的本地语音听写应用，所有处理在设备端完成，确保隐私和低延迟。其技术亮点在于结合轻量级语音转文字引擎与自训练的 AI 增强模型，能实时纠正识别错误，显著提升准确率。与云端方案不同，它完全离线运行，数据不外传。你可以用它进行语音输入、快速记笔记或作为免提工具。对于开发者，还可训练自定义模型或将其集成至工作流中，适合需要隐私和速度的场景如会议记录或专注写作。
items.summary_en: FluidVoice is a fast, on-device dictation app for macOS that runs entirely locally, ensuring privacy and low latency. Its core innovation combines a lightweight speech-to-text engine with a custom-trained AI enhancement model that corrects recognition errors in real time, boosting accuracy. Unlike cloud-based alternatives, all audio stays on your machine. Use it for voice typing, note-taking, or hands-free input. Developers can extend it by training custom models or integrating into workflows.

items.name: agents-cli
items.summary: agents-cli 是一个命令行工具，能将任意编程助手转变为在 Google Cloud 上创建、评估和部署 AI 代理的专家。它通过提供专业技能集，与编程助手（如 Gemini）集成，利用 Google 的 Agent 开发工具包（ADK）自动化代理从开发到部署的全流程。开发者可安装 agents-cli，快速初始化代理项目，进行迭代评估，并一键部署到 Google Cloud，从而极大提升开发效率，降低手工操作的复杂性。
items.summary_en: agents-cli is a CLI tool that turns any coding assistant into an expert for building, testing, and deploying AI agents on Google Cloud. It extends assistants with specialized skills for agent creation, evaluation, and deployment, leveraging the Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Gemini. Developers can integrate it into their workflow to rapidly prototype agents, run evaluations, and deploy seamlessly to Google Cloud, reducing manual overhead.

items.name: astryx
items.summary: Astryx 是一个开源设计系统，旨在解决多项目UI不一致与维护困难的问题，同时使界面天然适配AI智能体。其核心技术洞察在于：通过基于设计令牌的主题引擎和可组合的React组件实现完全定制，团队无需修改源码即可全面控制外观与行为。实际使用中，可快速搭建品牌组件库，并扩展自有令牌或集成LLM驱动的界面生成器，创建动态、适配智能体的界面。
items.summary_en: **summary_en (96 words)** Astryx is an open-source design system that solves the problem of inconsistent, hard-to-maintain UI across projects while preparing interfaces for AI agents. Its key technical insight is full customizability through a design-token-based theming engine and composable React components, giving teams total control over look and behavior without forking. You can use it to quickly scaffold a branded component library, then extend it with your own tokens or integrate it with LLM-driven UI generators for dynamic, agent-ready interfaces. **summary_zh (145汉字)** Astryx 是一个开源设计系统，专门解决UI开发中一致性差、难以维护的问题，同时让界面天然支持AI智能体。技术上，它通过“设计令牌+可组合组件”的架构实现完全定制——你只需改几个token就能换掉整套主题，无需修改源码。实际使用时，你可以用它快速搭建品牌组件库，再结合LLM驱动的界面生成工具，让AI自动输出符合你设计规范的页面。

items.name: Instatic
items.summary: Instatic 是一款自托管可视化 CMS，可在一分钟内快速部署，简化静态网站内容管理。它融合可视化页面构建器与轻量级 Markdown 后端，无需编码即可实时编辑和发布内容。技术亮点在于将所见即所得编辑体验与静态站点生成器结合，并保持内容可移植性。用户可通过 Docker 或 Node.js 快速运行，连接任意静态站点生成器，实现可视化内容管理工作流。适合小型团队或个人项目，帮助快速搭建带编辑后台的静态网站，运维成本极低。
items.summary_en: Instatic is a modern visual CMS you can self-host in under a minute, designed to simplify content management for static websites. Unlike traditional CMSs, it combines a live visual page builder with a lightweight Markdown-based backend, letting you edit and publish content without coding. You can run it as a Docker container or Node.js app, connect it to a static site generator, and manage content visually—perfect for small teams or personal projects wanting a fast, no-fuss editorial workflow.

items.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
items.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
items.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

items.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
items.summary: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 是一个紧凑的多语言句子编码模型，专门解决跨语言语义理解难题，支持50多种语言的文本相似度计算。它通过知识蒸馏技术将大型多语言Transformer的能力压缩到轻量级12层架构中，同时保持跨语言语义对齐特性，让模型在不同语言间准确捕捉相同含义。开发者可直接用它构建多语言语义搜索系统、实现跨语言文档分类，或作为特征提取器用于下游NLP任务，只需输入任意支持语言的文本即可获得高质量的语义向量表示。
